Own the AI and product roadmap for the Modern Manufacturing digital platform: predictive maintenance, inventory, dynamic scheduling, connected assets and operational metrics.
Architected a conversational assistant over a 3D digital twin on CUDA-accelerated NVIDIA AI Factory, Omniverse and NeMo agents; piloted across four US and UK plants.
Two invention disclosures: hierarchical clustering for predictive maintenance in low-data regimes, and hybrid RAG for supply chain.
Promoted to Director in 2025, my second promotion that year.

Presented at NeurIPS 2022 (AI for Accelerated Materials Design workshop) within four months; became my MIT Sloan thesis.

builds.title: Baby Senses Lab
builds.text: Developmental world models with one network per sense, each fed age-filtered input, plus a public site that shows a photo, video or sound the way a baby of a chosen age might sense it.

builds.title: Digital Twin History
builds.text: An open, cited history of digital twins and physical AI, from andon lights and Apollo's simulators to live factory twins and AI world models. Dataset and interactive site.

builds.title: Michelin Kitchen Twin
builds.text: A browser-based 3D twin of a three-star kitchen running a full dinner service, modeled like a manufacturing plant: covers are the build plan, every plate a bill of materials.

builds.title: Auto-Twin
builds.text: From a walkthrough video to a live digital twin: a world-model splat converted to OpenUSD, bound to cloud telemetry and rendered in the browser, Blender or Omniverse.

builds.title: LabTrends
builds.text: An offline, privacy-first Android app that turns scattered lab reports into per-person health trends, with on-device OCR and a small local model. No cloud, no accounts.

builds.title: India Iceberg Index
builds.text: Maps how exposed India's workforce is to generative AI, district by district, by combining occupational AI-exposure scores with national labor survey data.
